data.gender_notes: Rea is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Rea was the goddess of the harvest, the mother of the gods, and the consort of Zeus. She was also identified with the Roman goddess Ceres. The name Rea carries the meaning “Moon goddess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rea usually hope their child will grow to embody moon goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_latin.name: Rea

in_english.name: Rea
